needed.evidence: A continuous concrete wall topped with barbed wire runs along the entire visible length of the left side, with no sidewalk or safe space for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved footway along the base of the wall to provide a safe, continuous walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The narrow informal path on the right is completely obstructed by a large red delivery truck and other parked vehicles.
needed.suggestion: Enforce no-parking zones or install physical barriers to keep the pedestrian path clear of vehicles.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the right appears uneven and is partially covered by puddles and debris.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the informal path to remove trip hazards and improve drainage.

needed.evidence: There is a clear crossing demand due to the presence of a shop and a residential area, but no marked or unmarked crossing facility is visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at the junction of the shop and the residential street to provide a safe crossing point.

needed.evidence: There are no street lights visible along the road in any of the frames.
needed.suggestion: Install street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers.
